description: This file defines the interface ConnectionLifecycle, which manages the life cycle of a connection to an Hono service, including establishing connections, handling disconnect/reconnect events, and checking connection status.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the underlying AMQP connection to the service and returns a Future that completes with the connection or fails if unable to connect.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified when the connection is lost unexpectedly.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified when the connection has been re-established after loss.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is currently established, returning a Future that succeeds if connected or fails with ServerErrorException.

methods.name: isConnected (default method)
methods.description: Default implementation that simply returns the result of isConnected().

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the service without attempting to reconnect.

methods.name: disconnect (with handler)
methods.description: Disconnects from the service and notifies the provided handler about the operation's result.
